itinerary.title: Aswan High Dam, Unfinished Obelisk, Philae
itinerary.source: You board in time for lunch, and a felucca sail around Kitchener's Island closes the day before the ship departs for Kom Ombo overnight.

itinerary.title: The river days: Kom Ombo and Edfu
itinerary.source: The middle day is the river at its most purposeful — two major temple stops, a long afternoon of sailing, and Luxor by evening.

itinerary.title: Luxor East Bank: Karnak and Luxor Temple
itinerary.source: The evening is aboard, moored at Luxor.

itinerary.title: Luxor West Bank and out
itinerary.source: The final day crosses to the West Bank — the land of the dead, where the New Kingdom pharaohs were buried in the desert cliffs.
